applicableAreas: 5-foot electric easements on east and southeast property boundaries
findings.comment: Trees are proposed along the eastern property boundary where 5-foot electric easements are depicted on the Site Plan. However, no License Agreements from Austin Energy Public Involvement are referenced or documented on any submitted plan sheets. UCM § 1.10.10.3 requires a License Agreement before installing landscaping within electric easement areas. Verification required before certificate of occupancy.

applicableAreas: 5-foot electric easements along eastern and southeastern property boundaries where mitigation trees are proposed
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows mitigation trees (M) along the eastern boundary where Site Plan depicts 5-foot Electric Easements. However, the Landscape Plan does not display the easement boundaries or show specific distances from tree locations to easement edges. Easement boundary overlay is necessary to verify trees are positioned at the outer edge of the easement and not blocking lateral access for Austin Energy personnel and equipment.

applicableAreas: entire site; all landscape plan sheets
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) does not show Austin Energy overhead and underground facilities depicted on the Preliminary Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21). Specifically absent: underground electric lines, transformer pads, pull boxes, electric easement boundaries, and overhead electric lines. Without electric facilities depicted on the landscape plan, the proximity of proposed trees to electric infrastructure cannot be verified for code compliance.

applicableAreas: transformer pad areas and easement zones
findings.comment: No written Austin Energy approval documentation is visible on landscape or utility coordination sheets. Required documentation may include approval letters, emails, plan notes signed by Austin Energy representatives, or Austin Energy Design approval stamps. Cannot verify whether any deviations from standard clearance distances or species requirements have received explicit written Austin Energy approval per UCM § 1.10.10.4.
